title: Banking & bank transfers
description: Receiving accounts, bank connections, statement imports and reconciliation of incoming transfers.

overview.noConnections: No bank connections yet – add a receiving account and a connection, or upload statement files.

reasonHint.NO_REFERENCE: The transfer text contains no payment reference.
reasonHint.UNKNOWN_REFERENCE: A reference was found but no order has it (typo, wrong check digit or another prefix).
reasonHint.UNDERPAYMENT: The amount is lower than the outstanding amount of the referenced order.
reasonHint.OVERPAYMENT: The amount exceeds the outstanding amount, or the order was already paid.
reasonHint.ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE: The referenced order is cancelled, expired or refunded – the money may have to be returned.
reasonHint.AMBIGUOUS: Several orders are referenced and the amount does not equal their sum.
reasonHint.NAME_MATCH_ONLY: No reference, but the sender's name resembles a buyer with an open order.
reasonHint.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The transfer currency differs from the order currency.

adapterHint.FINTS: Downloads transactions directly from the bank's FinTS server with the online-banking login. PSD2 approvals (TAN / app) are requested in this portal.
adapterHint.PSD2_FINAPI: Account access through the licensed provider finAPI. The bank login happens in finAPI's web form.
adapterHint.FILE_IMPORT: Upload statement exports manually. Configure the CSV column mapping here if your bank's CSV is not detected automatically.
adapterHint.IMAP: Watches a mailbox for statement e-mails and imports their attachments automatically.

accounts.title: Receiving accounts
accounts.description: Accounts printed in the bank transfer instructions and reconciled automatically.

form.name: Internal name
form.accountHolderHint: Shown to customers in the payment instructions.
form.isDefaultHint: This account is printed on bank transfer order confirmations.

accounts.connectionsDescription: How transactions of this account reach the platform. Several connections can be combined – duplicates are recognised.
accounts.deleteDescription: Only possible while no transactions were imported. Accounts with transactions can be deactivated instead.

fields.name: Name
fields.pollIntervalHint: Leave empty for manual sync only. Minimum: {minutes} minutes.
fields.lookbackDaysHint: Period requested on the first sync; later syncs fetch since the last success (minus one week).
fields.serverUrlHint: HTTPS address of your bank's FinTS server (published by the bank, e.g. on its online-banking help pages).
fields.customerIdHint: Only if your bank uses a customer ID different from the login name.
fields.productIdHint: Every FinTS installation needs its own product registration from the German banking industry (free of charge). It is stored only here, never in the code.
fields.secretKeep: Stored encrypted – leave empty to keep the current value.
fields.tanMethodHint: Offered by the bank after the first sync. App approvals (decoupled) are confirmed in this portal or polled automatically.
fields.tanMethodNone: Run a first sync to load the procedures
fields.tanMediumHint: Only required if the bank asks for it; name of the registered device.
fields.preferCamtHint: Uses camt.052 when the bank offers it (richer data), otherwise MT940.
fields.backgroundUpdate: Refresh bank data before each download
fields.backgroundUpdateHint: Uses one of the max. 4 automatic bank accesses per day (PSD2). Disable when finAPI's automatic batch update is booked for your client.
fields.secureHint: Off = plain connection upgraded with STARTTLS when offered (port 143).
fields.processedMailboxHint: Leave empty to keep them in the folder (they are tagged as imported).
fields.senderAllowlistHint: One address or @domain per line. Empty = any sender (not recommended).

csv.hint: Leave on automatic for common German online-banking CSV exports. Map columns only if detection fails.
csv.headerRowHint: Line number of the column headers; empty = detect.

actions.deleteDescription: Imported transactions and statement files are kept. finAPI access and consent are revoked.

setupIssue.TAN_METHOD_REQUIRED: Choose the TAN procedure below and save, then sync again.
setupIssue.TAN_MEDIUM_REQUIRED: The bank needs the TAN medium (device name) – enter it below.
setupIssue.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: The IBAN of this account is not among the accounts of this login.
setupIssue.STATEMENTS_NOT_SUPPORTED: The bank does not offer statement downloads for this account via FinTS.

finapi.title: finAPI bank login
finapi.notConnected: Not connected yet. Open the web form, select the bank and log in – the consent is granted to finAPI.
finapi.accountNotFound: The IBAN of this account was not found in the bank login. Available: {ibans}
finapi.userActionRequired: The bank requires a new login / consent renewal.

tan.title: TAN required – {connection}
tan.intro: The bank asks for a TAN to continue. The sync waits until {time}.
tan.decoupledIntro: Approve the request in your banking app. It is detected automatically; you can also confirm here once approved. Waiting until {time}.

review.title: Clarification cases
review.description: Incoming transfers the system could not assign automatically. Assign them to an order with one click or dismiss them.
review.empty: Nothing to clarify – all incoming transfers are assigned.
review.noCandidates: No matching order found automatically – search below.
review.previewPaid: Order already paid – recorded as overpayment
review.searchPlaceholder: Order number, reference, name or e-mail
review.amountHint: Leave empty to assign the whole remaining amount ({amount}). Enter less to split a collective transfer.
review.ignoreDescription: Use this for transfers that do not belong to an order (e.g. other income). The note is kept for the audit trail.
review.previewAdjustment: Assigns the exact amount to the open additional payment.

imports.title: Statement imports
imports.description: Upload camt.053 / camt.052 (XML), MT940 or CSV exports of your bank – also as ZIP. Files already imported are recognised, as are bookings that arrived through another channel.
imports.drop: Drop statement files here or click to choose
imports.result: {imported} new, {duplicates} duplicates, {matched} matched automatically, {review} to clarify

upload.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: The account was not found or is inactive.

reverse.title: Reverse the assignment to order {order}?
reverse.description: Use this when a transfer was matched to the wrong order. Consequences:
reverse.consequencePayment: The payment is cancelled and the amount counts as not yet assigned.
reverse.consequenceOrder: A paid order goes back to "awaiting payment" (same payment reference; the seats stay reserved).
reverse.consequenceTickets: Its tickets become invalid immediately and cannot be scanned any more.
reverse.consequenceCreditNote: If an invoice was issued, a credit note cancels it completely. Paying the order again issues a new invoice and new tickets.
reverse.consequenceTransaction: The transaction returns to the review cases so you can assign it to the right order. The customer is not notified.
reverse.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Transfer belongs to order T-2026-0042
